# proxmox_backup_not_backed_up (Data Source)

Lists the guests that have no backup yet according to `/cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up`, sorted by VMID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_backup_not_backed_up" "all" {}
```
